summary: KNOT Offshore Partners LP filed a Form 6-K containing a press release of interim Q1 2026 results. The filing reports financial highlights including revenues of $92.0 million, operating income of $14.7 million, and net income of $2.6 million, as well as fleet utilization of 97.2% for scheduled operations. It also notes that a prior unsolicited non-binding proposal from Knutsen NYK to acquire all publicly held common units for $10 cash per unit was terminated on March 19, 2026, after discussions failed, with no current agreement. The filing is a routine earnings release and does not announce a new special situation.
